review.notes: Full review. Sample: all 11 seeded targets (1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 4.1, 4.2, 5.1); 17 of 37 source locators read at the text (Buergisser 12, Shpilka-Yehudayoff 4, Chabaud-Deshpande-Mehraban 1); the 17 locators into Saptharishi's survey and the 3 into Cai-Chen-Li could not be read from a legal place and are listed as not verifiable. Adversarial pass with computed values for every statement: Ryser and Glynn to side 4, both VNP witnesses and their gate counts, the clow recurrence and its sign to n = 5, the formula matrices on 400 random formulas, the Mignon-Ressayre Hessian determinant and ranks for m = 3, 4, 5 over Q and modulo 2, 3, 5, 7, 11. 50 Mathlib and 3 Tau Ceti declarations opened at the pins. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; no theorem closes with one tactic; elaborated types compared with the README. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks: all passed, none set aside. No overlap with another roadmap found.
